name: Do I need architectural plans for a detached garage project?

mainEntity.name: Do I need architectural plans for a detached garage project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, architectural plans are typically required for detached garage construction, especially for permitting and ensuring structural integrity. These plans detail the garage's layout, dimensions, structural elements, foundation, roofing, and any electrical or plumbing work. Professional plans ensure compliance with local building codes and help contractors accurately bid and execute the project. Engaging an experienced designer helps translate your vision into a constructible design.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, architectural plans are usually required for permits and to ensure structural integrity, detailing all aspects of the garage's construction.
